subject: german
note: The 2024 Pearson Edexcel GCSE German (1GN0) spec is built on six thematic contexts plus prescribed vocabulary and grammar, not the older 'Theme 1/2/3' model. The six official thematic contexts and the vocabulary/grammar appendices have been distributed across the three theme units below; the Skills unit lists the four assessed papers and their official sub-components.

units.n: Theme 3 — Communication and the world around us

subs: Paper 1 Speaking — Read aloud, Role play, Picture task with conversation
Paper 2 Listening and understanding — Listening, Dictation
Paper 3 Reading and understanding — Reading, Translation into English
Paper 4 Writing — Open-response tasks, Translation into German
